Wide cinematic garden-level photograph of a modest, beautiful English Georgian country house. Warm honey limestone, sage-painted sash windows, a muted oxblood front door, delicate wisteria around the entrance and a lavender-lined gravel garden path. The house is framed in the central and right two thirds; a softly shaded garden and dark natural foliage occupy the lower left third, providing a calm area for a website headline.
